items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: I know them from Ben Coe... Ben Coe was the leader of the band... With Ben Coe and D.D. They had Hollywood. Jim Robinson... Jim Little.

ctx.x: What extremists did Ben Coe play? He was the leader.
Ben Coe was the leader of the band, a day-range band down in Blackmon.
